youtube_title: Why You Get ZERO Matches on Dating Apps 💔 #Shorts
youtube_description:
100 right swipes, 0 matches, then 'buy a Boost'.

In a Woo survey of 20,000 Indian users, 74% were men and 26% women: about 3 guys per girl. Apps are free, but getting seen first or seeing who liked you costs money. The frustration is the business.

Rule: fix your profile before paying, and don't make the app your only plan.

Source: Woo survey of 20,000 users, via Business Insider India.
